facts.text: The LEAD Award offers $2,000 each year to residential students and $1,000 to commuter students who participate in campus and community activities.

sources.title: Lead Award Program - William Woods University
sources.quote: The LEAD Award program is an annual tuition award granted to all undergraduate students, regardless of financial need, who commit to campus and community involvement.

sources.title: Lead Award Program - William Woods University
sources.quote: An award of $2,000 is possible for residential students and $1,000 for commuter students each year.
